CustomField.description: The deliberation half of output, broken out. Output includes it and it counts against max_tokens, so a truncated read is ambiguous without this: a small answer behind a long deliberation and a long answer with none look identical on output alone. Written by: Receipt, summed from the provider's own usage block. Read by: nobody in the pass - TELEMETRY IS OBSERVATION AND NO BRANCH MAY READ IT, so a number that is wrong can never be a run that is wrong.
CustomField.label: Thinking Tokens
